description: Group J handlers (REQ-J1..J9) are STUBS that return {status: 'recovered'} without performing the spec'd recovery action. REQ-J1 mandates 'launch camofox + Gmail OTP automatic OAuth completion' — j1_auto_login is a 2-line return. REQ-J2 mandates 'git fetch origin main + signature verify + git checkout' — j2_auto_rollback is a 2-line return. REQ-J3 mandates 'firecrawl npmjs.org + trust-author check + auto-PR' — j3_auto_research is a 2-line return. REQ-J4 (model ladder), REQ-J5 (tmux kill-server + cache purge + git pull), REQ-J6 (strategy halve + REQ-C3 gate + resurrect-at), REQ-J9 (probe CLAUDE_USAGE_ENV + parse pane footer + 4x penalty) — all 2-line stubs returning 'recovered' with no behavior. The docstring 'Production wires these to real recovery actions' is the exact AI-slop signal (iv) the manifest flags. Stubs pass tests because tests monkeypatch them, but no production code path actually recovers any failure mode.
